completed_stage_receipts.summary: Confirmed two linked defects: a tentative user idea/question was inferred as implementation authority, and unprotected-main risk was overclassified using the wrong multi-writer threat model.
Classified USER_PROPOSAL_INFERRED_AS_DECISION_OR_CANONICAL_MECHANISM as recurrent and DIRECT_MAIN_THREAT_MODEL_MISCLASSIFICATION as first-observed.
Mapped hot-path routing, maintenance semantics, durable commit receipts, writer lease, GitHub main authority and external mutation primitives.

Existing cold-path candidate semantics had already been accepted, so recurrence escalated to a minimal hot-path entry invariant plus regression; direct-main repair moved to mutation-integrity semantics rather than branch workflow.
External scouting was not required: the failure is internal and current connector primitives provide the needed HEAD-level CAS mechanism.
Reused existing hot-path entrypoint and commit-observability owner; created no new root policy, registry or permanent agent.
Rejected no-change because the behavior recurred; rejected mandatory PR-first as mismatched complexity; accepted independent-assessment hot-path rule plus direct-main HEAD CAS.
Resolved the current writer topology, lease, branch state and available CAS primitive without turning a retrievable fact into a user decision.

Escalated only the recurrent anti-canonicalization invariant to ENTRYPOINT; kept detailed semantics in the existing maintenance policy and direct-main commit integrity in the existing progress/commit policy.
Minimal design added one concise hot-path invariant, one commit-integrity section and focused regressions without PR lifecycle or new authorities.
Preserved direct main, deleted the erroneous HIGH-by-default threat-model conclusion and increased concurrency integrity with HEAD CAS at lower operational cost than PR-first.

Re-completed implementation after both reopen findings: the anti-inference rule remains hot-path and within budget; direct-main HEAD-CAS is the operational contract; SYSTEM_BLUEPRINT states the SINGLE_ACTIVE_CHAT threat model; HANDOFF no longer treats unprotected main as a HIGH defect or PR-first as default; the experimental PR-first branch remains unmerged and non-authoritative.
Final aligned implementation checkpoint passed risk-tiered control-plane audit, Agent architecture harness and full pytest on authoritative main.
Classified the change as a Universal control-plane invariant. It propagates through bootstrap/progress semantics and requires no BUSINESS lease, business-state rewrite or copied owner-local rule.

Second-order review found no remaining scoped contradiction after the alignment repair: stale HIGH wording is removed, PR-first experiment has no PR and is non-authoritative, direct-main CAS is architecture-aligned, and HARNESS monitor booleans remain explicitly lower-authority historical cache. Assurance remains bounded: repository rules cannot physically stop an authorized actor that deliberately ignores protocol, and CI does not prove independent semantic/live-outcome correctness.

Durable learning is now bound to authority: user proposals remain candidates until independently assessed or explicitly instructed; Universal material main mutation under SINGLE_ACTIVE_CHAT uses active-lease plus observed-HEAD CAS, CI and reread; unprotected main alone is not classified HIGH under this threat model. The trajectory closed only after one real CI reopen for hot-path bloat and one second-order reopen for stale HANDOFF semantics.

reopen_history.reason: CI validation found ENTRYPOINT hot-path budget regression: 8447 bytes exceeds the 8192-byte limit. Preserve the invariant but compress its hot-path expression; detailed semantics remain in cold-path policy.

After corrective M8 validation passed and M9 found no BUSINESS-state propagation requirement, M10 second-order review found the authoritative HANDOFF still labels unprotected main as HIGH and recommends mutation-gateway/branch-protection closure. That stale threat-model conclusion would reintroduce the rejected PR-first framing on future continuation. The architecture map also needed one high-level direct-main HEAD-CAS statement so the detailed progress policy was not isolated.
